turns.content: yaar ajeeb sa scene ho gaya hai. Manav — mera school ka dost, chhe saal se saath reh rahe hain — woh shift ho raha hai, apni fiancée ke saath rahega. Baat theek hai, hona hi tha shaadi se pehle. Par mujhe yeh building ke WhatsApp group se pata chala. Owner ne pucha "flat mein naya banda kab aa raha hai?" Main wahin baitha tha. Mujhe usne bataya hi nahi tha ab tak.

Yaar, that's a proper gut-punch. Chhe saal saath rehna, dost, and phir building group se pata chale ki woh nikal raha hai? Woh bhi fiancée ke saath. Baat logically theek hai, shaadi se pehle shift hona normal hai, lekin yeh "mujhe bataya hi nahi" wala hisaab alag dard karta hai.

Main samajh sakta hoon tu kaisa feel kar raha hoga — thoda left out, thoda "kya hum itne close nahi the?" wala scene. Kabhi-kabhi log itne apne duniya mein busy ho jaate hain (fiancée, shaadi ki planning) ki closest logon ko update dena bhool jaate hain. Intentionally nahi, bas happen ho jaata hai.

Tu usse baat karna chahta hai ya abhi thoda process kar raha hai pehle? Main sun raha hoon.

phir raat ko usne casually bola "haan yaar batane hi wala tha, busy chal raha tha." Busy? Chhe saal ek kamre mein rahe hain, uski har cheez mujhe sabse pehle pata hoti thi. Uska rishta pakka hua toh main mithai leke uske ghar gaya tha. Aur ab main building group se pata karta hoon ki mera ghar khali ho raha hai.

Haan yaar, woh “busy chal raha tha” sunke aur zyada chubhta hai. Chhe saal ek hi kamre mein, uski har khushi-ghami pehle tujhe pata chalti thi, rishta pakka hua toh tu mithai leke ghar gaya — aur ab yeh casually nikal diya jaise koi chhoti si baat ho. Building group se pata chalna, phir yeh excuse… lagta hai jaise tu uske life ke important chapter se bahar ho gaya.

Yeh dard valid hai. Dost itna close ho toh expect karna normal hai ki pehle tujhe bataye, busy ke naam pe nahi. Intentionally hurt karne ki baat nahi shayad, lekin feel toh wahi hota hai — left out.

Ab tu kaisa feel kar raha hai uske baad? Aur usse seedha kehna chahta hai yeh ya abhi just nikalne de raha hai andar se? Main yahin hoon, bol.

It's fine. I have made my peace with it. People get married, people move on, priorities change. This is how life works. I will figure out the flat situation. It is not a big deal and I would prefer not to make it one.

Got it, yaar. You’ve made your peace and that’s completely valid. People do move on, priorities shift, and you’re choosing not to turn this into a bigger thing. That’s a solid way to handle it.

You’ll figure the flat out — I know you will. If it ever sits heavier later and you just want to vent or think out loud, I’m right here. No pressure, no making it a thing. Just here. Take care.

soch raha hoon usko bas itna reply kar doon — "Congratulations. I will start looking for a new flatmate from next week." Simple, clean, no drama. Usko bhi clear ho jayega aur mujhe bhi baar baar explain nahi karna padega. Theek hai na yeh?

Haan, yeh simple aur clean hai — koi drama nahi, koi lambi explanation nahi. “Congratulations” se tu positive rakhta hai, aur next line se clearly bata deta hai ki tu aage badh raha hai. Usko samajh aa jayega ki tu process kar chuka hai aur ab practical side dekh raha hai.

Agar tera mann hai ki dosti waisi hi rahe, toh thoda sa warmth add kar sakta hai, jaise “Congratulations yaar. Main next week se naya flatmate dekhna shuru karunga.” Bas itna. Warna jo tune socha hai, woh bhi theek hai — short, seedha, no extra weight.

Jo tujhe abhi sahi lage, wahi bhej. Tu decide kar.
